XY series · STS

Steam Siege

Released August 3, 2016 · 116 cards

Expanded

Steam Siege is a Pokémon TCG expansion in the XY series, released in English on August 3, 2016. Its main set has 114 cards, plus 2 secret rares numbered beyond the set (116 in total). It includes 105 Pokémon, 11 Trainer and 0 Energy cards, and is legal in the Expanded format (rotated out of Standard).

Illustrators

52 illustrators worked on Steam Siege. Most cards: 5ban Graphics (18), Toyste Beach (5), Ken Sugimori (4), Eske Yoshinob (3), Hajime Kusajima (3), Masakazu Fukuda (3), match (3), Megumi Mizutani (3).
